This estimation outlines the development of a mobile banking application that includes OAuth2 authentication, PSD2 open banking compliance, strong customer authentication, and a transaction ledger. The project will be divided into distinct phases: requirements gathering, API development, transaction ledger implementation, and testing/QA. A conservative estimation has been prepared, including a 20% risk buffer to account for unforeseen complexities and issues that may arise during development.

Phase 1: Requirements Gathering — 1 week(s), 4000 EUR. Gather and finalize requirements with the client, including technical specifications and compliance needs. Ensure clarity on all PSD2 and OAuth2 requirements. This phase involves meetings, documentation, and design mockups to ensure alignment with the client's vision. (based on general judgment, not grounded in retrieved data)
Phase 2: API Development — 3 week(s), 15000 EUR. Develop the APIs necessary for OAuth2 authentication, strong customer authentication, and other features. This will include implementing security protocols and ensuring PSD2 compliance. Techniques from historical projects inform that such API integrations tend to have complexities, thus the buffer is included here. (grounded in retrieved historical data)
Phase 3: Transaction Ledger Implementation — 2 week(s), 10000 EUR. Implement the transaction ledger system, including double-entry accounting and reconciliation features. This may involve data modeling, database setup, and ensuring strong audit trails which historically require more effort than expected. (grounded in retrieved historical data)
Phase 4: Testing and QA — 2 week(s), 8000 EUR. Conduct thorough testing phases for the entire application, focusing on edge cases, security measures, and user experience. This will include both automated and manual testing to ensure thorough coverage and compliance with regulations, anticipating several issues in implementation. (based on general judgment, not grounded in retrieved data)

Total duration: 8 week(s). Total cost: 37000 EUR.
ground_truth: A close match to a historical fintech project of this exact shape: OAuth 2.0 authentication backend, PSD2 open banking connectors (account information + payment initiation with strong customer authentication), a transaction ledger service, and push/email notifications. Raw effort ~480 hours: authentication backend ~120h, PSD2/SCA connectors ~160h, transaction ledger ~140h, notifications ~60h. With the standard 20% risk buffer, buffered effort is ~576 hours (~36,000 EUR at 62.50 EUR/h), over roughly 7-8 weeks for a small team. Main risks: PSD2/Berlin Group compliance scope creep, SCA exemption handling complexity, and regulatory sign-off timelines outside the team's control.
